hypothesis: Forecasting skill rises LR < LightGBM(current) < LightGBM(+lags) on onset PR-AUC (pooled LODO).
predicted_outcome: lag > cur > lr on PR-AUC; modest gains because onsets are few.

hypothesis: A GRU dynamics model rolled K steps and read by a GBDT head beats LightGBM(+lags).
predicted_outcome: No win: within the bootstrap CI of lag. Data is too small for dynamics learning to add signal.
actual_outcome: CONFIRMED: world PR-AUC=0.104 vs lag=0.117 (lag 90% CI 0.031-0.206)

hypothesis: Shuffling history order hurts models that use dynamics.
predicted_outcome: lag loses <10% relative PR-AUC (its signal is the current bucket); world loses a similar small amount.
actual_outcome: CONFIRMED: relative PR-AUC change under shuffled history: lag +2.1%, world +15.7% (negative = worse). Shuffling does NOT hurt: no evidence either model uses temporal order (signal is the current bucket).

hypothesis: Stage of the forecast attack is predictable across days.
predicted_outcome: Fails under leave-one-day-out: each day's stage is unseen in the other days (accuracy <= majority).
actual_outcome: CONFIRMED: stage accuracy 0.00 vs majority 0.50 over 714 onset buckets

hypothesis: SECONDARY split: when attack types are shared between train and test (first 60% of each host-day trains, last 40% tests, gap >= K+L), forecasting and stage forecasting are much stronger than leave-one-day-out.
predicted_outcome: lag PR-AUC >= 1.5x its LODO value and stage accuracy above the majority baseline.
actual_outcome: CONFIRMED: blocked lag PR-AUC=0.234 (prevalence 0.058) vs LODO 0.117; blocked stage accuracy 0.63 vs majority 0.58

hypothesis: Technique can be recognised from one host-minute's behaviour in a held-out week of the same campaign.
predicted_outcome: High for the bursty techniques (Brute Force, Active Scanning: PR-AUC >= 0.9); clearly lower (< 0.7) for at least one of the low-volume ones (Exploit, Valid Accounts, Exfil).
actual_outcome: PREDICTION REFUTED: PR-AUC Active Scanning 1.00, Exploit Public-Facing App 1.00, Valid Accounts 1.00, Brute Force 1.00, Exfil Over Alt. Protocol 0.85

hypothesis: Recent technique history predicts the next burst: history models (own/all-technique) and the renewal hazard beat the state-only model.
predicted_outcome: sched >= 1.5x state (macro PR-AUC); renewal within 10% of sched (the schedule is a renewal process).
actual_outcome: PREDICTION REFUTED: macro PR-AUC state 0.060, renewal 0.189, own 0.206, sched 0.221 (base rate 0.067)

hypothesis: The GRU world model (dynamics rolled K steps + GBDT head) beats the schedule-feature GBDT.
predicted_outcome: No win: world <= 1.05x sched. Nothing beyond time-since-last-burst is learnable from these logs.

hypothesis: Shuffling the order of the 150-minute history hurts the history models.
predicted_outcome: sched loses >= 15% relative macro PR-AUC (recency is the signal).
actual_outcome: PREDICTION CONFIRMED: sched 0.221 -> shuffled 0.159 (-28%); world 0.212 -> shuffled 0.158 (-26%)

hypothesis: ABLATION (breaks the no-timestamp rule, not shipped): adding minute-of-hour shows how much of the future is a fixed schedule.
predicted_outcome: clock >= 2x sched: bursts fire once per clock hour at a random minute, so the wall clock is far more informative than history.

hypothesis: Other techniques' history helps forecast a technique (kill-chain progression exists).
predicted_outcome: No: own-technique history within 3% of all-technique history (techniques run as independent schedules).

hypothesis: A detector trained on three other labs' corpora ranks unseen volumetric families (CIC-2017 DDoS, port scan) above benign host-minutes.
predicted_outcome: ROC-AUC >= 0.9 for both, but no better than the flow-volume heuristic (gbdt - volume <= 0.05): volume is the whole signal.
actual_outcome: PREDICTION REFUTED: DDoS gbdt 0.88 vs volume 1.00; port scan gbdt 0.93 vs volume 0.84

hypothesis: The same detector transfers to low-volume or stealthy families (Heartbleed, CTU-13 botnet spam/C&C).
predicted_outcome: No: ROC-AUC < 0.7 on Heartbleed and < 0.75 on the botnet.

hypothesis: A benign-only anomaly detector (IsolationForest) transfers better than the supervised detector.
predicted_outcome: No: its mean ROC-AUC over held-out families is <= the supervised detector's.
actual_outcome: PREDICTION REFUTED: mean ROC-AUC over 13 families: IsolationForest 0.79, supervised 0.55, volume heuristic 0.65

hypothesis: World-model surprise (GRU next-minute prediction error, trained on benign minutes of the other corpora, no attack labels) transfers as well as IsolationForest.
predicted_outcome: Not better: mean ROC-AUC over held-out families <= IsolationForest + 0.03.
actual_outcome: PREDICTION CONFIRMED: mean ROC-AUC: surprise 0.71 vs IsolationForest 0.79

hypothesis: Detectors trained on the other corpora transfer to DAPT2020's pentest stages.
predicted_outcome: Mostly no: ROC-AUC <= 0.7 for at least 3 of the 4 DAPT stages.
actual_outcome: PREDICTION CONFIRMED: DAPT stages ROC-AUC Reconnaissance 0.75, Initial Access (foothold) 0.42, Lateral Movement 0.44, Exfiltration 0.46
